if: goods are removed for transportation in one of the four cases in rule 55(1)(a) to (d)
a delivery challan is issued in lieu of an invoice under rule 55(1)
then: the delivery challan MUST carry the consignee's name, address and GSTIN or Unique Identity Number, if the consignee is registered
note: One mandatory particular of rule 55(1)(iii), addressable on its own so that a missing field names the clause it breaches.

evidence.quote: name, address and Goods and Services Tax Identification Number or Unique Identity Number of the consignee, if registered;
